breadcrumb: Std 6 Science (English) — Unit 5: The World of Animals — Book-back (பாடநூல் வினாக்கள்)

questions.quote: The study of living beings or organisms is called a. Psychology b. Biology c. Zoology d. Botany

en.q: The study of living beings or organisms is called ______.
en.explanation: Biology is the natural science concerned with the study of life and living organisms; zoology and botany are its branches.

ta.q: உயிருள்ள பொருள்கள் அல்லது உயிரினங்களைப் பற்றி படிப்பது ______.

questions.quote: Which of the following are the characteristics of living beings? (i) Respiration (ii) Reproduction (iii) Adaptation (iv) Excretion

en.q: Which of the following are characteristics of living beings? (i) Respiration (ii) Reproduction (iii) Adaptation (iv) Excretion
en.explanation: All four are characteristics of living beings.

ta.q: எவை உயிருள்ளவற்றின் பண்புகள்? (i) சுவாசம் (ii) இனப்பெருக்கம் (iii) தகவமைப்பு (iv) கழிவு நீக்கம்

questions.quote: All animals need a. food and water only b. water only c. air, food and water d. food only

en.q: All animals need ______.
en.explanation: Air, food and water are essential for all animals.

questions.quote: Which animal has the special organs of breathing called gills? a. Earthworm b. Fox c. Fish d. Frog

en.q: Which animal breathes with special organs called gills?
en.explanation: Gills are the respiratory organs of fish.

ta.q: செவுள்கள் எனும் சுவாச உறுப்பைப் பெற்றுள்ள விலங்கு எது?

questions.quote: Birds fly in the air with the help of a. heavy and strong bones b. soft and thick bones c. hollow and light bones d. flat and thick bones

en.q: Birds fly in the air with the help of ______.
en.explanation: Birds have hollow, light bones.

questions.quote: Paramecium moves from one place to other with the help of ____. a. pseudopodia b. flagella c. foot d. cilia

en.q: Paramecium moves from one place to another with the help of ______.
en.explanation: Paramecium lives in water and moves with cilia.

questions.quote: Kangaroo rat lives in a. aquatic habitat b. desert habitat c. grass land habitat d. mountain habitat

en.q: The kangaroo rat lives in a ______ habitat.
en.explanation: The kangaroo rat does not drink water and gets water from the seeds it eats.

ta.explanation: கங்காரு எலி நீர் அருந்தாமல் விதைகளிலிருந்தே நீரைப் பெறுகிறது.

questions.quote: Water bodies, deserts, mountains are called ____.

en.q: Water bodies, deserts and mountains are called ______.
en.explanation: The living or dwelling place of an organism is its habitat.

questions.quote: Based on the number of cells present animals are classified into ____ and ____.

en.q: Based on the number of cells, organisms are classified as ______.
en.explanation: Organisms are unicellular or multicellular.

ta.q: செல் எண்ணிக்கையின் அடிப்படையில் உயிரினங்கள் ______ என வகைப்படுத்தப்படுகின்றன.
ta.explanation: உயிரிகள் ஒரு செல் அல்லது பல செல் உயிரிகள்.

questions.quote: Tail of a bird acts as a rudder which helps to ____.

en.q: The tail of a bird acts as a rudder and helps it to ______.
en.explanation: The tail helps the bird to control the direction of movement.

ta.q: பறவையின் வால் திசை திருப்புக் கட்டையாகச் செயல்பட்டு ______ உதவுகிறது.

questions.quote: The lizard ____ on the ground with its claw on its feet.

en.q: Lizards grip the ground with the ______ on their feet.
en.explanation: Lizards are quadrupeds; clawed feet help them grip the ground.

ta.q: பல்லிகள் கால்களில் உள்ள ______ மூலம் தரையைப் பற்றுகின்றன.

questions.quote: Camel stores ____ in its hump.

en.q: A camel stores ______ in its hump.
en.explanation: A camel can break down stored fat for energy.

questions.quote: Habitat is a living or dwelling place of an organism. (True/False)

en.q: Which statement is correct about habitat?
options: Habitat is the number of cells in an organism.
Habitat is the body part of an organism.
Habitat is the food of an organism.
Habitat is the living or dwelling place of an organism.
en.explanation: A habitat is the place where an organism lives.

ta.explanation: ஓர் உயிரினம் வாழும் இடமே அதன் வாழிடம்.

questions.quote: The geographical features and environmental conditions on earth remain same from one place to other. (True/False)

en.q: The geographical features and environmental conditions on earth ______.
options: are the same in all habitats
differ from one place to another
en.explanation: Conditions such as land form, temperature and rainfall differ from place to place, giving different habitats.

ta.explanation: நில அமைப்பு, வெப்பநிலை, மழை போன்றவை இடத்திற்கு இடம் மாறுபடுவதால் வெவ்வேறு வாழிடங்கள் உருவாகின்றன.

questions.quote: Amoeba is a unicellular organism and it moves with pseudopodia. (True/False)

en.q: Which is correct about the amoeba?
options: It is unicellular and moves with pseudopodia.
It is unicellular and moves with wings.
It is multicellular and moves with fins.
It is multicellular and moves with cilia.
en.explanation: Amoeba is a single-celled organism that moves by pseudopodia (false feet).

options: அது பலசெல் உயிரி; குறு இழைகளால் நகரும்.

questions.quote: Birds can see only one object at a time. (True/False)

en.q: Birds have ______, so they can see one object with one eye and another object with the other eye.
options: eyes only at the back of the head
a single eye in the front
eyes on the sides of the head
en.explanation: A bird's eyes are on the sides of its head, so each eye sees a different area and it can look at two objects at once.

ta.q: பறவைகள் ஒரு கண்ணால் ஒரு பொருளையும் மறுகண்ணால் வேறொரு பொருளையும் பார்க்க முடியும், ஏனெனில் அவற்றுக்கு ______.
ta.explanation: பறவையின் கண்கள் தலையின் இருபக்கங்களில் உள்ளதால் ஒவ்வொரு கண்ணும் வெவ்வேறு பகுதியைப் பார்க்கும்; ஒரே நேரத்தில் இரு பொருள்களைக் காண முடியும்.

questions.quote: Paramecium is a multicellular organism. (True/False)

en.q: Paramecium is a ______ organism.
en.explanation: Paramecium is made of a single cell and moves with cilia.

ta.explanation: பாரமீசியம் ஒரே செல்லால் ஆனது; குறு இழைகளால் நகர்கிறது.

questions.quote: Some living things are made of a single cell, called ____ organism.

en.q: Organisms made of a single cell are called ______ organisms.
en.explanation: Amoeba, paramecium and euglena are unicellular.

ta.q: ஒரே ஒரு செல்லால் ஆன உயிரினங்கள் ______ உயிரினங்கள் எனப்படும்.

questions.quote: The breathing organ of a fish is known as ____

en.q: The breathing organ of a fish is known as ______.
en.explanation: Gills absorb oxygen dissolved in water.

questions.quote: Name the locomotory organ of Amoeba.

en.q: The locomotory organ of an amoeba is the ______.
en.explanation: Pseudopodia (false feet) help in movement.

questions.quote: Which structure helps the bird to change its direction while flying in air?

en.q: The structure that helps a bird to change direction while flying is the ______.
en.explanation: The tail of the bird helps it to control the direction of movement.

ta.q: பறவைகள் பறக்கும்போது திசையை மாற்ற உதவும் உறுப்பு ______.

questions.quote: Differentiate between unicellular and multicellular organisms.

en.q: Which one is a unicellular organism?
en.explanation: Amoeba, Paramecium and Euglena are unicellular; earthworm, fish, frog, lizard and man are multicellular.

questions.quote: Write the adaptive features of polar bear and penguin.

en.q: Which adaptive feature is found in the polar bear?
en.explanation: Polar bear: thick skin for protection and white fur. Penguin: paddle to swim and walks on two legs.

ta.explanation: துருவக் கரடிக்குத் தடித்த தோலும் வெண்ணிற உரோமமும் உண்டு; பென்குயினுக்கு நீந்த துடுப்பு உண்டு.

questions.quote: Mention the features that help a bird to fly in the air.

en.q: Which of these helps a bird to withstand the pressure of air while flapping its wings?
en.explanation: Strong chest muscles help withstand the air pressure during flapping.

ta.q: இறக்கையை அடிக்கும்போது காற்றழுத்தத்தைத் தாங்க பறவைக்கு உதவுவது ______.
ta.explanation: வலிமையான மார்புத் தசைகள் காற்றழுத்தத்தைத் தாங்க உதவும்.
